_comment: RyzeSMP Suggestions Bot egg - derived from parkervcp 'node.js generic'. Installs ONLY the suggestions-bot/ subfolder; builds TypeScript and the native better-sqlite3 module in the Node.js 22 runtime to avoid ABI mismatches.
name: RyzeSMP Suggestions Bot
author: noreply@ryzesmp.local
description: Automated AI suggestions & voting Discord bot for the RyzeSMP Minecraft server. Clones the suggestions-bot/ subfolder from a public GitHub repo, installs dependencies with npm ci --include=dev and builds with npm run build in the Node.js 22 runtime. SQLite data in ./data persists across restarts and code updates.
startup: cd /home/container; if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then /usr/local/bin/npm ci --include=dev || /usr/local/bin/npm install; fi; if [ ! -d dist ]; then /usr/local/bin/npm run build; fi; /usr/local/bin/node /home/container/${MAIN_FILE} ${NODE_ARGS}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# RyzeSMP Suggestions Bot - installation script
# Installs ONLY the suggestions-bot/ subfolder from the repo.
# Dependencies + build run on first START (Node.js 22 runtime) to keep the
# native better-sqlite3 binary ABI-compatible.
# Server Files: /mnt/server

apt update
apt install -y git curl ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo "USER_UPLOAD enabled - skipping git clone."
    exit 0
fi

GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS:-https://github.com/mio530/Minecraft-mods}"
if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git"
fi
BRANCH="${BRANCH:-claude/ryzesmp-suggestions-bot-ezzqro}"

# Optional auth (public repo => not required)
if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

echo "Cloning branch ${BRANCH} ..."
rm -rf /tmp/rsbot
git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" /tmp/rsbot

if [ ! -d /tmp/rsbot/suggestions-bot ]; then
    echo "ERROR: suggestions-bot/ not found in branch ${BRANCH}."
    exit 1
fi

# Copy only the bot. Existing data/ and node_modules (not in repo) are kept.
cp -a /tmp/rsbot/suggestions-bot/. /mnt/server/
# Drop the old build so the next start rebuilds the current code automatically.
rm -rf /mnt/server/dist
rm -rf /tmp/rsbot

echo "Install complete. Dependencies + TypeScript build run on first start."
exit 0

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description: Public GitHub repo to clone. Leave as default for RyzeSMP.

variables.name: Install Branch
variables.description: Branch that contains suggestions-bot/.

variables.name: Main file
variables.description: Entry file started with node. Max 16 characters.

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot > Reset Token). Keep secret.

variables.name: Discord Client ID
variables.description: Application (Client) ID from General Information.

variables.name: Discord Guild ID
variables.description: Your Discord server (guild) ID.

variables.name: Staff Role IDs
variables.description: Comma-separated staff role IDs. Empty = fall back to Manage Guild permission.

variables.name: Submission Channel ID
variables.description: Optional. Leave empty and run /suggestion setup to auto-create channels.

variables.name: Voting Channel ID
variables.description: Optional. Leave empty and run /suggestion setup to auto-create channels.

variables.name: Log Channel ID
variables.description: Optional. Leave empty and run /suggestion setup to auto-create channels.

variables.name: AI Provider
variables.description: openai | anthropic | none. 'none' uses the deterministic fallback (no API, no tokens).

variables.name: AI API Key
variables.description: API key for the chosen AI provider. Only needed if AI_PROVIDER is not 'none'.

variables.name: AI Model
variables.description: Model name, e.g. gpt-4o-mini (openai) or claude-haiku-4-5 (anthropic).

variables.name: Voting Duration (days)
variables.description: Auto-close voting after this many days. 0 = never.

variables.name: Minimum Votes
variables.description: Minimum total votes considered meaningful in the evaluation summary.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: debug | info | warn | error

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Not used by this egg (updates are done via Reinstall). Kept for compatibility.

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description: 1 = skip git clone (you upload files yourself). 0 = clone from GitHub (default).

variables.name: Additional Node packages
variables.description: Extra npm packages to install (space separated). Normally empty.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Only for private repos. Leave empty - RyzeSMP repo is public.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Only for private repos. Leave empty - RyzeSMP repo is public.

variables.name: Additional Arguments
variables.description: Extra arguments passed to node. Normally empty.
